observations: Photo 0 and Photo 1 show the same black vintage-style sewing machine with gold ornamental details.
The machine has a large handwheel on the right, a metal needle bar, and a flat bed with a metal plate.
The body is black with chipped paint and visible wear, especially on the gold decorations.
There is a small circular label near the base of the handwheel, but the text is too blurry to read.
The machine is placed on a wooden table in a workshop-like setting.
No power cord or motor is visible — it appears to be a manual treadle or hand-crank machine.
The seller's watermark 'CHIMA OBIGODSWILL POSTED ON JUJ' is overlaid on both photos.

claims.claim: A big head sewing machine to sew anything silk, lakra, leather, jean
claims.evidence: The machine appears to be a heavy-duty manual model, but there is no visible proof of its capability to sew leather or denim. The claim about 'anything' is not verifiable from the photos.
